text: is that what happened with soldify inside of the last studio also? @cart/hmsc-int/
resolution: Answered whether the old hmsc-int studio's solidify also produced an all-one-face solid: NO. The old studio (cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/editMesh.ts solidifyFaces, line 1556; invoked from studiokit/StudioViewport.tsx opSolidify line 1016) pushed the inner cap and every rim wall as its OWN EditMeshFace entry, and selection there operates on EditMesh face indices — so each wall/cap was individually clickable after solidify. The geometry algorithm is the same (cart/editor's TS solidifyFaces is a verbatim clone), but the one-face behavior arrived with the NATIVE resident-mesh port (framework/gpu/3d.zig meshSolidifySelection), where new triangles inherit the source face's authored group id and group-based picking selects the whole slab. No code changed — comparison answer only.
